title: Line-up on the Celestin records and the Black Rag title
summary: Foster lists the line-up on the records and discusses how Black Rag was really called Down Home Rag, renamed by the company; the recording man told him not to play so loud.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography
